title: [review] project-LICHEN-2auf.44.11.1.5: missing ZeroizeOnDrop derive on EdhocInitiator/Responder breaks edhoc feature build
description:
## Summary

Removing `#[derive(Zeroize, ZeroizeOnDrop)]` from `EdhocInitiator` (line 553) and `EdhocResponder` (line 981) while keeping `#[zeroize(skip)]` field attributes causes 8 compilation errors under `--all-features` (edhoc feature):

```
error: cannot find attribute `zeroize` in this scope
 --> lichen-oscore/src/edhoc.rs:XXX:7
```

The `#[zeroize(skip)]` attribute requires a `Zeroize` or `ZeroizeOnDrop` derive on the containing struct.

## Fix

Re-add `#[derive(Zeroize, ZeroizeOnDrop)]` to both structs. The manual `Zeroize` impls (lines 616, 1044) coexist fine with the derive — the derive creates `ZeroizeOnDrop` (Drop impl) and a default `zeroize()`, while the manual impl overrides `zeroize()` with the proper key-material wipe. The derive-generated Drop ensures zeroize-on-drop for state objects.

## Impact

P0: `cargo check -p lichen-oscore --all-features` has 34 errors; 8 of which are introduced by this commit (HEAD~1 had 56, so the commit improved overall but introduced this regression).

HEAD~1: 56 errors → HEAD: 34 errors. Net -22 errors, but 8 new. Pre-existing errors (parse_bstr, encode_identifier, etc. not defined) remain.

## Verification

```bash
cd rust && cargo check -p lichen-oscore --all-features
```
